metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Heart of the Beast
metas.description: After a harrowing plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Mayday
metas.description: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · The End of Oak Street
metas.description: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Minions & Monsters
metas.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2026 · Enola Holmes 3
metas.description: Detective Enola Holmes heads to Malta, where her aspirations merge in her most complex and dangerous case yet.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2026 · Supergirl
metas.description: Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes too close to home.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Masters of the Universe
metas.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Swapped
metas.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
metas.description: Mario ventures into space, exploring cosmic worlds and tackling galactic challenges far from the familiar Mushroom Kingdom.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
metas.description: A "Man From the Future" arrives at a diner in Los Angeles where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intel...

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Send Help
metas.description: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2026 · Greenland 2: Migration
metas.description: The surviving Garrity family must leave the safety of the Greenland bunker and embark on a perilous journey across the decimated frozen wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2025 · Anaconda
metas.description: A group of friends are going through a mid-life crisis. They decide to remake a favorite movie from their youth but encounter unexpected events when they enter the jungle.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · The Running Man
metas.description: A man joins a game show in which contestants, allowed to flee anywhere in the world, are pursued by "hunters" hired to kill them.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2025 · Tron: Ares
metas.description: A highly sophisticated program, Ares, is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Bad Guys 2
metas.description: The Bad Guys are struggling to find trust and acceptance in their newly minted lives as Good Guys, when they are pulled out of retirement and forced to do "one last job" by an all-female squad of criminals.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Superman

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2025 · Heads of State

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2025 · The Old Guard 2

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: A world-renowned K-Pop girl group balance their lives in the spotlight with their secret identities as demon hunters.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Elio
metas.description: Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination, finds himself on a cosmic misadventure where he must form new bonds with alien lifeforms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions and somehow discover who he is truly meant ...

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · How to Train Your Dragon

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Ballerina

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Predator: Killer of Killers
metas.description: Three of the fiercest warriors in human history become prey to the ultimate killer of killers.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A lonely Hawaiian girl befriends a runaway alien, helping to mend her fragmented family.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2025 · Fountain of Youth

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Thunderbolts*

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2025 · A Minecraft Movie

metas.name: ★ 2.2 · 2025 · Snow White

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2025 · The Electric State

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Mickey 17

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2025 · Captain America: Brave New World
metas.description: Sam Wilson, the new Captain America, finds himself in the middle of an international incident and must discover the motive behind a nefarious global plan.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Gorge
